title:
Power Steering ECU
INSPECTION OF ECU
ocr_text:
STEERING — Power Steering (Progressive Power Steering)                    SR-95

Power Steering ECU
INSPECTION OF ECU

1. JACK UP VEHICLE AND SUPPORT IT ON STANDS

2. REMOVE GLOVE BOX
   HINT: Do not disconnect the ECU connector.

3. START ENGINE

4. MEASURE VOLTAGE OF ECU
   (a) Using a voltmeter, measure the voltage between ECU
       terminals SOL ⊖ and GND while the engine is idling.
       Standard voltage: 0.32 — 0.44 V

   (b) Place the transmission in gear and while running at
       about 50 km/h (31 mph), measure the voltage be-
       tween ECU terminals SOL ⊖ and GND.
       Standard voltage: Voltage measured in (a) above,
                         minus 0.09 — 0.23 V

   If no voltage, try another ECU.

5. INSTALL GLOVE BOX

6. LOWER VEHICLE
